contact.name: Abigail Pogson
contact.evidence_quote: Abigail Pogson ... Abigail joined the Barbican Centre as CEO in January. She is a Board Member of ECHO and was Chief Executive Officer at The Glasshouse International Centre for Music from May 2015 to October 2025, joining from Spitalfields Music, a charity based in east London with an international reputation for its quality, reach, and innovation.
